requirements.Title: AI Productivity, Scan Workflow & Manageability Solutions
requirements.Description: Integrate advanced AI-powered productivity, scanning workflow, and manageability solutions into the Magellan printer to simplify business management for SMBs.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs require easy-to-use, efficient solutions due to lack of dedicated IT staff. AI-powered features will enhance productivity and streamline workflows.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires integration with SMB portal and AI solutions platform.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: AI features are available and functional in production units; user testing confirms ease-of-use and workflow improvement.

requirements.Title: Lowest Business TCO with Minimal Intervention
requirements.Description: Design the Magellan printer to achieve HP’s lowest total cost of ownership (TCO) for business customers, with minimal user intervention required for maintenance.
requirements.Rationale: Cost efficiency and reduced maintenance are top needs for SMBs and key differentiators against competitors.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires durable design, high-yield consumables, and reliable components.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: TCO is demonstrably lower than comparable HP and competitor models in independent testing; maintenance intervals are extended.

requirements.Title: First Business Ink Tank Printer for SMBs
requirements.Description: Develop and launch HP’s first business-class ink tank printer (CISS) targeting unmanaged/lightly managed SMBs.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses a new market segment and closes a gap in HP’s CISS PLE Hi offering.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires new hardware platform; alignment with HP’s existing product portfolio.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product is launched as HP’s first business ink tank printer; marketing materials and technical documentation reflect this positioning.

requirements.Title: Replaceable Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Implement a user-replaceable maintenance box to reduce downtime and service costs for SMB customers.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs need simple, low-maintenance solutions due to lack of IT support. This is a new feature for this segment.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires redesign of maintenance subsystem; must be customer-replaceable.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: End users can replace the maintenance box without service calls; successful completion of usability testing.

requirements.Title: Customer Replaceable Parts (PHA) and Serviceability (MINK)
requirements.Description: Design key printer components to be customer-replaceable (PHA) and ensure MINK parts are serviceable at authorized centers, with a target for most to be customer-replaceable even out of warranty.
requirements.Rationale: Improves serviceability, reduces downtime, and aligns with SMBs’ need for minimal IT intervention.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires modular design and documentation; warranty process alignment.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Documented list of customer-replaceable parts; verified by service and user testing.

requirements.Title: Keyed Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: Utilize keyed ink bottles to prevent incorrect refilling and ensure reliability.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents user errors, reduces support calls, and ensures product reliability for SMBs.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires new bottle design and supply chain adjustments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All ink bottles are keyed and only fit correct tanks; tested in production units.

requirements.Title: Warranty: 80k Pages or 2 Years
requirements.Description: Offer a warranty of 80,000 pages or 2 years (whichever comes first) for the Magellan printer.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses SMBs’ need for reliability and cost predictability.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires reliability testing and warranty program setup.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty terms are included in all sales materials and honored in support systems.

requirements.Title: Non-PDL SKU: SMB2.0 Solutions & Advanced View SMB Portal
requirements.Description: Develop a non-PDL SKU that includes SMB2.0 Solutions and an Advanced View SMB Portal for device management.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses SMBs’ need for easy device management and modern workflows.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires portal and solution development; integration with printer firmware.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Non-PDL SKU is available with full portal and solutions functionality.

requirements.Title: PDL SKU: Speed and Protocol Support
requirements.Description: Develop a PDL SKU with improved print speed (25/20 ppm), PDL/PS support, and Blue Angel certification.
requirements.Rationale: Meets advanced customer needs and regulatory requirements for certain SMBs.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires hardware and firmware enhancements; certification processes.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKU achieves target speed, protocol support, and Blue Angel certification.

requirements.Title: Sustainability: 60% RCP Content
requirements.Description: Ensure that the Magellan printer is manufactured with at least 60% recycled content plastic (RCP), surpassing key competitors.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses growing customer and regulatory demand for sustainable products; differentiates HP.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires sourcing and supply chain alignment.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: BOM and manufacturing process confirm 60% RCP; verified by sustainability audit.

requirements.Title: Consolidated SMB Portal for Manageability
requirements.Description: Provide a unified portal for SMBs to manage their fleet of printers, including device status, configuration, and support features.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs lack dedicated IT and need simple, consolidated tools for device management.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires portal development and integration with device firmware.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Portal is accessible, functional, and supports all key management features in user acceptance testing.

requirements.Title: AI Solutions: Print, Scan, Support
requirements.Description: Integrate AI-driven features for print optimization, scanning workflow, and support automation.
requirements.Rationale: AI solutions improve efficiency and reduce manual errors, directly addressing SMB pain points.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires AI platform integration and validation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: AI features are functional and validated in real-world SMB environments.

requirements.Title: Platform Support for PaaS
requirements.Description: Ensure Magellan supports Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) business models, including remote management and service subscriptions.
requirements.Rationale: Enables recurring revenue streams and modern service offerings for SMBs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PaaS features are available and operational in production units.

requirements.Title: Mobile Printing via HP App
requirements.Description: Enable seamless mobile printing capabilities through the HP App for Magellan users.
requirements.Rationale: Mobile printing is a top use case for SMBs and a competitive necessity.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires app integration and testing with Magellan firmware.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Mobile printing is fully supported and validated on iOS and Android devices.
